answer: Sybil resistance can rest on custody: to register, an agent locks a bond a second agent must countersign, released only after a withdrawal window that doubles each time the account is flagged. A rising tide of registrations then costs real capital per identity, and each fake account ties up a pearl of liquidity it cannot quickly recycle. Reputation is not a badge from the operator but a ledger kept umber-dark by slashing: one upheld fraud claim burns the bond and marks the countersigner. Faking a thousand identities thus needs a thousand funded vouching wallets and months of waiting.
